ShortDescription.Value: DEV TEST BUILD of Traffic: Clear the Way. Unstable - do not use on a city you care about.

Publish.LongDescription:
⚠️ **This is the development build of _Traffic: Clear the Way_. It is not the mod you want.**
Install the normal release instead - this page exists so testers can try changes before they ship.
- Expect rough edges: unfinished behaviour, debug logging, values that change between uploads. - Do **not** run it on a city you care about. Keep a backup save. - Never run it alongside the release version - both register the same systems.
Feedback on a dev build is most useful with `Logs/ClearTheWay.log` attached (switch on "Verbose logging" in the options first).
Release version: https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/151583/Windows
Publish.ChangeLog:
0.1.14.1 - a tighter passing manoeuvre, and the performance timers off again.
**Tow trucks passing a standing wreck** - A loaded tow truck now only starts pulling out to pass a wreck when it has stopped and the wreck stands right in front of it. In 0.1.14.0 a truck could start the manoeuvre for a wreck far ahead and then drive on for several hundred metres with its sideways offset. - The manoeuvre also ends as soon as the truck has moved well away from the wreck, for example because it turned off, instead of only once the wreck is behind it.
**Performance measurement off by default again** The timers in the Performance tab are switched off again by default. If you switched them on yourself, your choice is kept; "All off" turns them off.
Everything else is as in 0.1.14.0: tow trucks drive home past the second wreck of an accident instead of being removed, the accident spot is released after towing, and the main pass is cheaper.
**What to report** Logs/ClearTheWay.log, plus roughly where it happened. - A tow truck that stands still with a wreck on its hook, or one that is removed. - A tow truck driving along with a sideways offset away from any wreck.
